question: I want to see the names of people who booked an offer at 'Timepass' and left a review less than 3 stars.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN bookings b ON b.requester_id = u.id JOIN reviews r ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id AND sd.id = r.shop_id WHERE sd.name = 'Timepass' AND r.rating < 3;
